---
applyTo: "**/*.md,docs/**"
---

# Documentation instructions

- Use Australian English.
- Prefer concrete, operational language over marketing language.
- Keep headings descriptive and sections scannable.
- Use relative links for repository-local files.
- Update documentation when user-visible behaviour, interfaces, deployment, configuration, or operating procedures change.
- Do not document behaviour that has not been implemented or verified.
- Avoid duplicating a source of truth that can be linked instead.
